ruling_1_r66_01.decision: REGISTER, CONDITIONALLY, AS THE CAMPAIGN'S ONLY MEASURED DISCOVERY CELL
ruling_1_r66_01.is_it_a_renamed_curve_spread: NO. It is a distinct mechanism and I rule it so on economics verified at source, not on the proposal's assertion. A curve spread is two points on ONE issuer's own curve: the traded factor is the slope of government yields, both legs share the same credit, the same funding basis and the same collateral status, and the spread cannot change sign for structural reasons. A Treasury-versus-short-rate spread is one point on the government curve against the collateralised/interbank rate at a matched point: the traded factor is the price of balance sheet, collateral scarcity, Treasury supply and the government-versus-interbank funding basis. That factor HAS gone negative in the post-2008 regime, which a curve spread cannot express at all. RATES_CARRY_CURVE_RV's closed scope is curve shape and does not cover this axis, and the 24-tuple declared list confirms no row exists. This is a new axis inside an exhausted class, not a rename.

frozen_construction.long_leg: ZN (10-year US Treasury future). LONG. Frozen. The 10-year is the canonical swap-spread point and has the deepest paired coverage in the certified layer (11,151 ret / 11,129 ret2, paired fraction 0.998).
frozen_construction.short_leg: SR3 (3-month SOFR future). SHORT, beta-scaled. Frozen.
frozen_construction.why_SR3_and_not_ZQ_decided_before_any_me: SOFR is a COLLATERALISED overnight rate and is the economically correct expression of the declared mechanism (collateral scarcity, balance-sheet cost, secured-versus-government funding). ZQ is a 30-day Fed Funds future on an UNSECURED policy rate; it measures policy expectations, not the collateral basis, so it does not express the declared channel. ZQ is additionally near-degenerate as a hedge leg: its return volatility is so low that a return-regression hedge ratio against ZN is numerically unstable. The choice is made now, on economics, so it cannot be made later in sight of a result. ZQ is NOT an authorised fallback: if SR3 fails a gate the cell is withdrawn, not re-run on ZQ.
frozen_construction.no_leg_variants: No ZF, no ZB, no TN long-leg variants. ONE structure. The declared prior is poor and I allot one slot, not three.
frozen_construction.hedge_ratio: Lagged rolling beta, BETA_WIN = 63 sessions, .shift(1) so the ratio used on session t was computable on t-1. Frozen at one window. No window variants. The beta is a HEDGE and may never be repurposed as a conditioning variable or a signal.
frozen_construction.conditioning: NONE. The structure is UNCONDITIONAL and ALWAYS-ON. No z-score, no entry band, no exit band, no momentum overlay, no regime filter, no carry filter, no volatility filter. See ruling 4.
frozen_construction.expected_sign: +1 on the structure as defined: LONG ZN, SHORT the beta-scaled SR3.
frozen_construction.why_that_sign_before_any_measurement: The convenience-yield channel. Treasury securities carry a safety, liquidity and regulatory-HQLA collateral premium that an interbank/collateralised short-rate claim does not, and the long leg additionally carries the term premium and curve roll-down that a 3-month rate future has no exposure to. A hedged long-government/short-secured-short-rate structure is therefore the a priori positive-carry direction. I declare the honest weakness with the sign: the LEVEL of the swap spread has structurally flipped sign in the post-2008 balance-sheet regime, so this prior is directionally reasoned but weak. That is precisely why the sign is frozen NOW. A negative outcome is a REFUTATION and is reported as one. No sign flip is permitted under any circumstance.
frozen_construction.cadence: Every 21st session on a FIXED calendar grid anchored to the first session of the frozen sample. Entry at the next open after the decision session.
frozen_construction.why_the_cadence_is_explicitly_not_month_: TREASURY_INDEX_MONTH_END_DURATION_EXTENSION is a closed mechanism, and the unconditional month-end ZN long (+1.47%/yr net, t 3.20 as a CONTROL) is a HUMAN_GATED blocked dataset. A month-end-anchored long-ZN structure would sit inside that blocked item. The grid is anchored to sample start, not to the calendar month, so the cell cannot collide with it.
frozen_construction.sample: 2018-05-07 to 2026-08-21, frozen. This is the full SR3 history in the R41 curve store (2,086 rows) intersected with ZN. Approximately 99 non-overlapping H21 observations. Thin, and declared thin.
frozen_construction.substrate: r41_curve_store_three_tenor_v1. DECLARED EXPLICITLY: SR3 and ZQ are in the 105-market registry and the R41 curve store and are ABSENT from the certified 68-market dated-contract layer. This cell does NOT run on the certified layer and may never be reported as if it did.
frozen_construction.cost_model: ZN charged the certified rates cost, 2.0 bps per side on traded notional. SR3 is NOT in the certified layer and therefore carries NO certified per-market cost: it is charged the PANEL MAXIMUM cost_bps_per_side, never the cheapest and never the rates 2bp figure, unless and until data-foundation-agent publishes a certified per-market cost for SR3. cost_model_state = MODELLED_NOT_OBSERVED.
frozen_construction.margin_and_committed_capital: Margins in futures_market_registry.json are CURRENT_ONLY_NOT_POINT_IN_TIME. The exchange SPAN spread credit for a ZN/SR3 structure is UNKNOWN and is material. Any return on committed capital MUST be reported with the margin-offset assumption stated as an assumption, never as data.
frozen_construction.primary_statistic: THE INCREMENT OVER A VOLATILITY-MATCHED PASSIVE BENCHMARK, not the raw return on committed capital. Frozen now, before measurement.
frozen_construction.why_the_benchmark_is_frozen_now: This is the single most important freeze in this ruling. R43's strongest candidate (c43_986b5eb34ec6) earned 4.18%/yr on committed capital at t 2.69 and looked like alpha; against a volatility-matched passive long it added 0.64%/yr at t 0.40 and was refuted on a Zone C sign flip. A static hedged structure's honest benchmark is NOT zero, it is the passive alternative. Declaring it before the number exists is what prevents the raw committed-capital figure from being presented as alpha.

gate_A_hedge_materiality.test: The beta-scaled SR3 short leg must remove at least 25% of the unhedged ZN leg's return variance over the frozen sample.
gate_A_hedge_materiality.computed_from: LEG VARIANCES AND COVARIANCE ONLY. No signal, no position, no return series, no P&L.
gate_A_hedge_materiality.why: ZN has roughly 6.5 years of duration; SR3 is a three-month rate future. A single SR3 contract cannot duration-match ZN, so the 'hedge' here is an empirical return beta, not a DV01 match. If that beta removes only a trivial share of ZN's variance, the structure is not a hedged relative-value trade at all - it is the HUMAN_GATED unconditional long ZN book wearing a hedge as a disguise, and measuring it would be measuring a blocked item under a new name.
gate_A_hedge_materiality.on_failure: The cell is WITHDRAWN BEFORE MEASUREMENT. Verdict DATA_HOLD / STRUCTURE_NOT_HEDGED. Burden charge ZERO. NO_ALPHA_EVIDENCE MAY NOT BE FILED.

gate_B_minimum_detectable_effect.test: A pre-registered minimum-detectable-effect curve at the frozen sample size, cadence and cost model, computed before any return. The cell proceeds only if the MDE is small enough to separate zero from the economically relevant effect size on the INCREMENT statistic.
gate_B_minimum_detectable_effect.computed_from: Leg variances, frozen cadence, frozen cost model. No signal, no return.
gate_B_minimum_detectable_effect.why: R60's FUT_BASIS_MOMENTUM_COMMODITY died at |t| < 0.69, a band that could not separate zero from the published 5-10%/yr effect, and the census records it as UNDERPOWERED, NOT DEAD, BLOCKED, not reopenable, and settled only by a pre-registered MDE curve. That cell now sits in its family's denominator forever having answered nothing. Approximately 99 non-overlapping H21 observations on a 2018-2026 sample is exactly that risk profile. I will not repeat R60's mistake by discovering the power problem after the number exists.
gate_B_minimum_detectable_effect.on_failure: The cell is WITHDRAWN BEFORE MEASUREMENT. Verdict DATA_HOLD / WITHDRAWN_UNDERPOWERED. Burden charge ZERO. NO_ALPHA_EVIDENCE MAY NOT BE FILED.

part_1_re_measuring_R43s_already_prosecu.decision: PERMITTED ONLY AS A DECLARED RE-LOOK WITH NO DISCOVERY STATUS. Never as discovery.
what_that_status_forbids: It may NEVER be filed as QUALIFIED.
It may NEVER enter the final tournament as an entrant or a survivor.
It may NEVER receive a director_clear ruling.
It may NEVER be published as a candidate or handed to signal-publishing-agent.
It may NEVER be described as alpha, as an edge, or as a discovery, in any artifact or any message.

It may NEVER be filed as NO_ALPHA_EVIDENCE either. A re-look on consumed history is not a discovery test in EITHER direction, and a weak number from it is not evidence of absence any more than a strong number would be evidence of presence.
part_1_re_measuring_R43s_already_prosecu.what_it_is_legitimately_for: SIZING AND FEASIBILITY ONLY. It answers 'what is this structure worth per dollar of committed capital to a book that already holds something else', which is a portfolio-construction input. It does not answer 'is there alpha here', and it is not permitted to be read as if it did.
part_1_re_measuring_R43s_already_prosecu.why_permitted_at_all: The estate genuinely never asked this question - R43 reported the unconditional structure only as a CONTROL - and the question it answers is a portfolio question, not a discovery question. part_1_re_measuring_R43s_already_prosecu.burden_charge: ZERO, because it carries no discovery status. This is conditional: the moment anyone attempts to give it a discovery verdict, a sign, a gate result or a tournament entry, it becomes an experiment and MUST be pre-registered and charged. ruling_4_fourth_sighting_audit.question: Is any cell at risk of being the FOURTH sighting of timing a premium with a conditioning variable?
ruling_4_fourth_sighting_audit.decision: YES, ONE IS, AND IT IS REFUSED BEFORE MEASUREMENT.
ruling_4_fourth_sighting_audit.r66_02: IS the fourth sighting. Residual mean-reversion over 21 sessions on a beta-hedged commodity-currency spread reduces to a z-score entry band on a spread. Refused under ruling 2, before pre-registration, before any return.
ruling_4_fourth_sighting_audit.r66_01: IS NOT the fourth sighting, and is frozen so that it cannot become one. The structure is UNCONDITIONAL and ALWAYS-ON: it has no entry rule, no exit rule, no threshold and no state variable. There is nothing in it that can be tuned toward a result because there is nothing in it that decides when to be on.
binding_freezes_that_make_that_true: NO z-score, NO entry band, NO exit band, NO signal threshold, NO regime filter, NO volatility filter, NO carry filter, NO momentum overlay, NO macro conditioner. Not one conditioning variable of any kind.
The lagged rolling beta is a HEDGE RATIO and is not a signal. It may not be thresholded, ranked, z-scored, sign-tested or used to decide whether the position is on. It sets size only.
BETA_WIN = 63 sessions, .shift(1), ONE value. No window variants, no window sweep, no window chosen after the fact.

Any proposal from the owning agent to add an entry band, a conditioning variable, a second beta window, a second short leg or a second long leg is A NEW EXPERIMENT requiring fresh pre-registration and its own burden charge. I REFUSE ALL SUCH PROPOSALS IN ADVANCE for this campaign. The owning agent is directed to escalate rather than adjust.
ruling_4_fourth_sighting_audit.the_generalised_test_i_am_recording_for_: If a proposed construction's position size or on/off state is a function of the CURRENT DEVIATION of the spread from its own history, it is premium timing and is refused before it is measured, whatever the family label on the front of it.

R43's own answer 7 already settled the operator's thesis: DID_RELATIVE_VALUE_OUTPERFORM_DIRECTION = YES. Every candidate that cleared its gate was a relative-value expression and no outright directional book cleared its own control. Re-confirming a confirmed thesis buys nothing.
56 candidates are FORWARD_FROZEN and the estate has never reconciled what they are worth as a PORTFOLIO. That is a large, already-paid-for inventory sitting unpriced.

FEASIBILITY, not signal, is the binding constraint on paper PnL at this NAV. The book is $99,127 NAV with $4,483 free cash. DATA_CERTIFICATION.instrument_availability_split records that the ONLY micro contracts owned are equity index and crypto: there is NO micro Treasury and NO micro FX contract in the estate. A single ZN contract carries $2,063 margin against $4,483 of free cash, and its notional is of the same order as the entire NAV. A beta-matched ZN/SR3 structure needs several SR3 contracts on top. It is entirely possible that r66_01, even if it wins every gate, is NOT IMPLEMENTABLE at this NAV - and that finding is worth more than the cell's result, costs zero burden, and can be computed today.

Every committed-capital number this estate has ever reported rests on an unquantified assumption. DATA_CERTIFICATION item 9 states that the exchange SPAN spread credit is UNKNOWN and is 'large for a calendar and material for a curve spread', and that margins are CURRENT_ONLY_NOT_POINT_IN_TIME so the error grows with distance into the past. R43's headline 4.18%/yr on committed capital inherits that. Pinning the margin-offset assumption down re-prices the estate's entire hedged-RV history.
